# Meitheal

Meitheal is a Home Assistant-native execution hub for households and homelabs.
It sits between task capture, daily planning, Home Assistant automations,
calendar and todo sync, companion flows, voice assistants, and agent tooling.

It is intentionally local-first, Astro-first, and Home Assistant-native.

## Deployment model

- Primary runtime: Home Assistant add-on
- Web runtime: Astro SSR
- Persistence: SQLite-backed repositories
- Auth model: Home Assistant ingress and Home Assistant integration surfaces
- Cloud requirement: none

## Current user-facing surfaces

- Dashboard
- Today
- Kanban
- Table
- Upcoming
- Calendar
- Projects
- Goals
- Habits
- Gamification
- Review
- Gantt
- Settings
- Offline fallback

## Core product jobs

### Capture and clarify work

- quick-add and full task modal
- descriptions, labels, due dates, favorites, recurrence, checklists
- task links and saved filters
- carried-forward triage and Today-focused workflows

### Work across multiple views

- dashboard and Today planning
- Kanban and Table management
- Upcoming, Calendar, Gantt, Projects, Goals, Habits, and Review surfaces
- shared SearchHub for tasks, views, settings, saved filters, and actions

### Connect work to the home

- Home Assistant todo entity and calendar sync
- Home Assistant services, sensors, notifications, and companion flows
- optional Grocy, Node-RED, n8n, webhook, and compatibility integrations

### Stay available everywhere

- searchable Settings shell
- PWA installability and offline support
- export and backup surfaces

### Work with voice and agents

- built-in Assist intents
- Home Assistant LLM API
- Astro MCP
- Home Assistant MCP
- A2A discovery and message routes
- experimental WebMCP direction

## Ubiquitous language

Canonical vocabulary:

- `Area` — life or operating domain
- `Goal` — desired outcome
- `Project` — bounded work in service of a goal
- `Task` — concrete unit of work
- `Routine` — repeatable work that spawns routine instances

Compatibility note:

- Some current UI, compatibility APIs, and integrations still expose legacy board, `task_type`, or `Epic/Story` language.
- Public docs use the newer model as canonical and call legacy language out only where it affects the reader.

## Web app and API surface

High-value routes:

- `GET /api/tasks`
- `POST /api/tasks/create`
- `PUT /api/tasks/:id`
- `DELETE /api/tasks/:id`
- `GET /api/tasks/:id/links`
- `POST /api/tasks/:id/links`
- `DELETE /api/tasks/:id/links?link_id=...`
- `GET /api/search`
- `GET /api/settings`
- `GET /api/health`
- `GET /api/ha/calendars`
- `POST /api/ha/assist`

## A2A surface

Discovery and routes:

- `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json` — static fallback agent card
- `GET /api/a2a/agent-card` — dynamic agent card
- `POST /api/a2a/message` — receive A2A messages
- `GET /api/a2a/tasks/{id}` — task status
- `POST /api/a2a/tasks/{id}:cancel` — cancel task

Dynamic skill model:

- 9 core skills: task management, task search, framework scoring, data export, areas, labels, today summary, habits, weekly review
- 2 HA skills when configured: calendar sync and entity state

Important limitation:

- The A2A routes are live but lightweight. Task-status and cancel routes currently return scaffolding rather than persisted long-running task state.

## Astro MCP

Astro MCP is exposed at `POST /api/mcp`.

Verified tool count: 18

Tools:

- `createTask`
- `searchTasks`
- `completeTask`
- `updateTask`
- `deleteTask`
- `getTask`
- `getCalendarEvents`
- `getUpcoming`
- `syncCalendar`
- `getOverdueTasks`
- `getTodaysTasks`
- `getTaskSummary`
- `batchComplete`
- `assignTask`
- `listUsers`
- `linkTask`
- `unlinkTask`
- `getTaskLinks`

## Home Assistant custom component

Primary HA entities:

- `todo.meitheal_tasks`
- `sensor.meitheal_active_tasks`
- `sensor.meitheal_overdue_tasks`
- `sensor.meitheal_total_tasks`

Primary HA services:

- `meitheal.create_task`
- `meitheal.complete_task`
- `meitheal.sync_todo`
- `meitheal.search_tasks`
- `meitheal.get_overdue_tasks`
- `meitheal.complete_task_by_tag`
- `meitheal.notify_overdue`

Voice and Assist:

- built-in Assist intents are registered without requiring an LLM
- `todo.meitheal_tasks` can be exposed to Assist
- the custom component auto-registers the `Meitheal Tasks` LLM API when supported by Home Assistant

## WebMCP

WebMCP is currently an experimental product direction. Treat it as documented
forward-looking protocol work, not as a mainstream runtime capability on stable
browsers today.

## Important operational notes

- Meitheal is designed for Home Assistant add-on deployment first.
- Do not assume one shared count or one shared tool list across all agent surfaces.
- Some legacy task and board terminology is still present in compatibility layers.
- Use Home Assistant auth and ingress expectations when describing access patterns.
